reddit.title: How do you verify Made-in-USA / Buy American Act domestic-content claims beyond a self-attested PDF?
reddit.body:
Buy American Act and Made-in-USA domestic-content claims are usually self-attested — a PDF that says the right things but that a contracting officer has no easy way to independently verify.

I've been working on GovChain, which hash-anchors the provenance record for those claims to Polygon, so it's a tamper-evident record instead of something sitting in a folder. The same tool also watches the federal System for Award Management's opportunity feed and scores each incoming notice against a contractor's capabilities with a plain-English pursue / monitor / skip call, plus an auto-drafted starting capability statement for what's worth pursuing. It tracks certification status (ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMC) too.

Curious how others here currently document and defend domestic-content claims — is self-attestation still the norm, or has anyone moved to something more verifiable?

https://govchain.us/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=govchain-fit-score&utm_content=b

Disclosure: I work on this project.
